newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas softens amid plant restarts.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas softens amid plant restarts.

text.p: Western Canadian natgas prices retreated Thursday as additional supplies became available in Alberta and mild weather continued in the Northwest, traders said.
"Field receipts finally started coming in," a Calgary-based trader said, as temperatures in Calgary were forecast to slip to a high of 62 degrees F on Friday, according to Weather Services Corp.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub was quoted early as high as C$1.65 per gigajoule, but prices then slipped to about C$1.58-1.60, indicating a daily loss of about 11 cents.
